## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Documentation updated (`docs/`, README, reference) where users would look
- [ ] Changelog line under `Unreleased` for user-visible changes
- [ ] If the agent's API shape changed: `scripts/capture-contract.sh` run and the result committed
- [ ] No unrelated refactors or formatting changes
- [ ] Respects the principles: pull-only agents, dashboard off the critical path, write-only secrets, config in a file
